title: SyncState as the release before the state dialect defined it (frozen: do not edit)
description: A verbatim copy of $defs.SyncState of schemas/sdlc-routing.schema.json, with the definitions that it references, as they were before the state dialect (design F.3, F.4 (5)). It stands for the code that a rollback returns to: tests/s3/sync-state-dialect.test.mjs checks that whatever the engine writes under `preserve` or `legacy` is valid under it, and that a `downstream` write is not, which documents the rollback window instead of hiding it. It is validated with strict mode off so that it can stay verbatim.

Sha.description: A full git object id: 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

UtcTimestamp.description: An ISO-8601 timestamp in UTC (the Z designator); fractional seconds are optional.

SyncState.description: The durable state of one upstream (SDLC_SYNC_STATE_<SLUG>): exactly 14 fields (SPEC-03 AC13). Every SHA is 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters; etag is the empty string until the first confirmed observation.
